fact: The plan gives the audited 2023/24 figure for public schools using SA-SAMS for reporting as 99.27% (21 255 of 21 412 operational public ordinary and special schools, Western Cape excluded because it does not collect through SA-SAMS), sets a 98% target for 2025/26, states that SA-SAMS is developed and maintained by the DBE and is being modernised into a web-enabled platform with NECT, and lists the modernisation as an unfunded mandate to be funded through partnerships, sponsorships and provincial departments.
title: 2025/26 Annual Performance Plan
